text:
elaine: Quick UX snag from the console QA: the docs panel title reads "Help Center" but left nav says "Docs" and CTAs vary between "Open docs" / "Read article". Users are confused which is canonical.

sam: I saw that. Also noticed some deep links lose anchors after redirecting from /help -> /docs. Bookmarks break.

raj: FYI our redirect rule currently does `return 301 /docs$uri;` which normalizes anchors away. I can change to `return 301 /docs$request_uri;` to preserve both query and anchors. Will need a quick cache key review.

maria: From copy: recommend we standardize on "Docs" for developer-facing content and use CTAs like "View in Docs: <article title>". Keep "Help Center" only for support docs. I'll draft a one-paragraph canonical blurb for the footer.

zoe: Accessibility checks: add `aria-label=\"Close docs panel\"` on the flyout close, ensure `role=dialog` with `aria-labelledby`, trap focus while open, and make link text descriptive (avoid "click here"). Also confirm contrast on the action button at small sizes.

link-bot: Link validator flagged 8 flyout links that 302 -> /docs without anchors. Logged LINK-995.

elaine: Plan: sam pushes UI copy PR (normalize CTAs + aria attrs), raj fixes redirect to preserve anchors, maria posts canonical copy, then run link-checker and accessibility quick pass. Any objections?

sam: No objections. I'll put up the PR tonight and request an a11y review.

raj: I'll target the redirect change tomorrow AM and add an integration test for anchors/querystrings.

maria: I'll post the footer blurb in RED-432 and ping here.

elaine: Thanks, team. We'll close when PR + redirect + LINK-995 are resolved.
